messages:
nina: deploybot blocked the release publish for billing-api. Reason: provenance mismatch between gcr and eu-ecr mirror. Tag 'release-2026' points to different digests.
omar: can you paste the reject line from deploybot?
nina: `deploybot: publish_reject reason=provenance_mismatch existing_repo=eu-ecr existing_digest=sha256:ff77... attempted_repo=gcr attempted_digest=sha256:gg88... policy=mirror-attestation-eq`
drew: probably the mirror job lost the cosign attestation metadata or the mirror used a different signer. Did you run cosign verify on both?
nina: ran quick checks: gcr digest gg88 has attestation buildid=2026-03-22-11, eu-ecr ff77 has an attestation but signed by a different key id and missing kms:signatureKeyId.
oncall-ops: prod is still on the previous digest, no traffic impact. we have two safe options: (1) republish into eu-ecr signed with canonical KMS key, or (2) pin the deployment to the eu-ecr digest temporarily.
omar: republish is better here so QA can continue with the canonical tag. we should do ephemeral republish and smoke canary before promoting.
nina: i can do the republish + sign. steps: copy from gcr by digest -> push to eu-ecr:republish-172750 -> cosign sign with KMS key + annotation.
drew: please include annotation `kms:signatureKeyId=projects/prod-kms/cryptoKeys/cosign-key` or policy will reject. Also record the original digests in the ticket.
release-bot: ACTION: created ticket RELEASE-2042 "billing-api mirror provenance republish" assigned to nina.
oncall-ops: proceeding with republish in 10m. will run canary 5rps for 3m after sign.
nina: commands I used:
```# copy
skopeo copy docker://gcr.io/redwood/billing-api@sha256:gg88 docker://eu-ecr.aws/redwood/billing-api:republish-172750
# cosign sign with kms and annotation
cosign sign --kms projects/prod-kms/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/cosign-key docker://eu-ecr.aws/redwood/billing-api:republish-172750 --annotation kms:signatureKeyId=projects/prod-kms/cryptoKeys/cosign-key
# verify
cosign verify --output=json docker://eu-ecr.aws/redwood/billing-api:republish-172750
```
nina: republish + sign done at 21:05 UTC, cosign verify confirms annotation and key id present. digest now sha256:hh99...
drew: starting canary at 5rps.
oncall-ops: canary results: 0 errors over 3 minutes.
omar: promote republish tag to release (atomic retag).
release-bot: ACTION: promoted eu-ecr:republish-172750 -> eu-ecr:release by oncall-ops.
nina: triggered deploybot re-run; publish now allowed.
release-bot: PUBLISH: billing-api:release allowed.
omar: follow-ups: 1) fix mirror job to preserve cosign annotations (drew), 2) alert when mirrored attestation key differs (omar), 3) add short note to release notes: "eu-ecr mirror required republish to restore KMS annotation; no prod impact."
drew: opening mirror fix PR and will add integration test.
oncall-ops: archiving logs to s3://redwood-logs/releases/1727501111-republish.
nina: closing the loop. leaving thread open 24h for any regressions.
